description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_FontFamily' which is responsible for validating and processing font-family CSS property values according to CSS specifications. It includes methods for handling generic font names, quoted font names, and unquoted font names, ensuring proper formatting and escaping.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_FontFamily
classes.description: A class for validating CSS font-family property values as per CSS specifications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a font-family string, processes generic font names, quoted names, and unquoted font names, and returns a properly formatted font-family list or false if invalid.
